en.topic_title: Gov’t refutes animal activist’s claims over stray dog culling following fatal mauling
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities have dismissed an animal rights activist’s claims that captured stray dogs will be subject to “convenience culling,” as eight unattended canines from Yuen Long were caught in a joint operation following a fatal mauling incident last week.



Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department personnel carrying out an operation to capture stray dogs in Yuen Long  on September 21, 2026. Photo: Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.
